patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: It's just heartburn — that gas-station burrito had it coming. Gimme a Tums and I'm outta here, I've got a 3 o'clock.
clinical.presentationShort: 58yo M — substernal 'heartburn,' radiating to jaw, onset at his desk.
clinical.presentationLong: 58-year-old male, substernal chest pressure he's calling heartburn, radiating to the jaw, started at his desk.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → 12-lead ECG in <10 min, ASA, cardiac monitor, troponin, activate cath lab
diagnosis.why: Nice catch — 'indigestion' + diaphoresis in a 58yo is an MI until proven otherwise. The vitals barely flinch; the tell is the sweat and the radiation. 🎯
diagnosis.redFlag: Diaphoretic + tachypneic — the sweat and the story don't match 'heartburn'

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.

signs: hand pressed to center of chest

aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 58-year-old man in a rumpled work shirt with a loosened tie, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: hunched slightly forward, one hand resting flat on the center of his chest. Expression: uneasy and unwell, quiet worry, jaw tight (not a big grimace). Clearly visible: beads of sweat on his forehead (diaphoretic), slightly gray washed-out skin, hand pressed to the center of his chest. Overall insists he's fine but plainly looks unwell. No text, no logos.
